senses.gloss: f. (יָרַד) going down, fall, decline, degradation. יְרִידַת גשמים rain-fall.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:2:20">Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵃ</cite> top; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Zevachim 53a:11">Zeb. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>יְרִידָתוֹ מן הכבש</he> his descent from the inclined plane (v. <cite ref="K00084"><he>כֶּבֶשׁ</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:1:2">Y. Hor. III, beg. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>עלייתו י׳ היא לו</he> his elevation (to office) would rather be a degradation to him (placing him under legal disadvantages).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 42:3">Ex. R. s. 42</cite> <he>שהיה לו י׳ מצד אחיו</he> degradation (excommunication) came to him from his brothers’ side.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 29:2">Lev. R. s. 29</cite> <he>כשם שלאלו י׳</he> as for these (nations) decline is in store; a. fr.—Pl. <he>יְרִידוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:10">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>ג׳ י׳ ירד שלמה</he> Solomon had three declining periods of his power.
